steps.name: Verify owned process sampling before source checkout
Acquire only the existing fixed SDK
Compile full host and XUL then authenticate native Shim

priorExecution.repairScope: Replace Darwin ps task/thread counters with identity-bound libproc task counters; preserve the already reviewed native startup diagnostics and all build/authentication pins.

timePolicy.partialSampling: Darwin uses identity-bound libproc task counters and runnable-thread summary; only ps PGID/PID inventory. Unknown remains incomplete, at most three snapshots 0.25 seconds apart, with confirmed gone/replaced generations distinguished from unavailable. Recovered observation gaps reset stall accounting; resource limits still apply.
timePolicy.stallRequires: 20 minutes with unchanged log, CPU time, process roster, stable RSS and disk space, and no runnable owned process

interpretation.threeDenials: Three distinct PID and birth tags; task ESRCH with complete valid same-owner BSD fallback; not the former same-PID EPERM control.

privateCompilationLog.reason: The fixed workflow kept stage logs only in the ephemeral Mac runner task directory, emitted marker counts, and uploaded no artifact. The local collector captured GitHub job metadata and job output, not runner-private stage logs.
